scope_of_work_and_exclusions: OUR SCOPE OF WORK (INCLUSIONS)
Backstage: remove existing floor finishes and adhesive throughout the hatched floor-demo area with a ride-on floor scraper, approx. 2,838 SF, phased per the phasing plan (AD-151 Plan Note 7)
Backstage: remove existing vinyl / rubber base at floor demolition areas, approx. 423 LF (AD-151)
Backstage: remove existing wall finishes at the north workroom and corridors - wainscot panels, FRP and corner guards, approx. 209 LF (AD-151)
Backstage: remove existing interior walls, approx. 37 LF, and one existing door, frame and hardware (AD-151)
Backstage: remove all existing furniture, workstations, work benches, tables and steel shelving fixtures U.N.O., approx. 40 shelving bays (AD-151)
Backstage: remove break room lockers, tables and chairs, kitchenette millwork and manager office equipment; vending machines and owner equipment emptied and disconnected by others (AD-151)
Backstage: remove kitchenette sink, faucet and cabinet after piping is cut and capped by the plumber (P-140)
Backstage: remove existing ceiling, grid, lighting and equipment at the manager office and the NE ceiling strip, approx. 127 SF (AD-171 Ceiling Note)
Backstage: remove existing strip lighting and equipment at the open-to-deck stock area, approx. 156 LF (approx. 39 fixtures), back to the nearest junction box (AD-171 Ceiling Note)
Backstage: remove supply diffusers, transfer grille and 8" / 10" branch duct and flex marked REX, approx. 6 EA and 75 LF (M-141 Mech Note)
Remote break space: remove existing chain link fencing and storage cages including gates, posts and top mesh, approx. 143 LF (AD-152)
Remote break space: remove all existing equipment and floor finish, approx. 1,062 SF (AD-152)
Remote break space: remove existing strip lighting and equipment, allowance 8 EA, back to the nearest junction box (AD-172)

Remote break space: remove existing supply ductwork, hangers and supports after the RTU is disconnected by the mechanical contractor, approx. 14 LF, and remove the floor drain body after capping by the plumber (M-142 Mech Note, P-140)
Phased night work - six (6) phases with return trips included per the Weekes ITB
Load-out of demolition debris to GC-provided dumpsters; daily clean up; leave demolition areas broom clean
All work conforms to state and local code requirements
ALTERNATES
Alternate No. 1 - Remote: sawcut, trench, excavate, backfill, compact and pour back slab for under-slab sanitary, approx. 40 LF x 2'-0" wide (P-151)
Alternate No. 2 - Remote: grind the +/-3/4" concrete pad down to align with the adjacent floor, approx. 113 SF (AD-152)
Alternate No. 3 - Backstage: grind residual adhesive / mastic after scraping, approx. 2,838 SF (AD-151 Plan Note 7)
ADDED EXCLUSIONS
Dumpsters and disposal fees - provided by others per the ITB.
Rooftop unit removal, refrigerant recovery, curb removal and roof infill / reroofing (M-142 - by mechanical contractor and landlord-approved roofer).
Cutting and capping of plumbing lines below slab, MEP disconnects and electrical make-safe; capping of floor power / communication outlets (AD-151 Notes 9, 11, 12).
Relocation of thermostats, BMS sensors and touch panels (M-141).
Removal of conduit and wiring beyond the nearest junction box or back to panel / source; electrical conduit support rack in Remote to remain (AD-172).
Restrooms, data / electrical room, panels, transformers, data racks, fire alarm and sprinkler equipment - existing to remain.
Slab X-ray / scanning, coring, trenching and sawcutting except as priced in the alternates; patching and repair of walls, floors and ceilings (AD-151 Notes 5 & 6).
Leveling, skim coat and floor prep for new finishes; identification of slab high / low points (AD-151 Notes 7 & 15).
Moving or emptying stock, Apple equipment, IT / AV equipment, vending machines and owner items; owner to clear each phase area before DDD mobilizes.
Sanitary scope inspection and new plumbing (P-151 General Note 1).
